serverAdmin.cors.star: A star alone allows every web page. Enter origins one by one, or https://*.example.com.
serverAdmin.cors.http: HTTP is for localhost only. Use {origin}.
serverAdmin.cors.invalid: Scheme, host and port, such as https://app.example.com.
serverAdmin.cors.header: That is not a header name.
serverAdmin.cors.starOff: While this is on, entries with a star match nothing.
serverAdmin.cors.refused.off: CORS is off or lists no origin.
serverAdmin.cors.refused.method: The origin is allowed, the method {method} is not.
serverAdmin.cors.note: Kalzit always answers the origin checked, never “*”. The check sends no request.
serverAdmin.signup.needMail: Mail server and public address are set
serverAdmin.signup.fixed: The link works 24 hours; requests expire after 14 days; a declined address waits 30 days.
serverAdmin.signup.domainBad: A domain such as example.com, without @ and path.
serverAdmin.visitor.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
serverAdmin.visitor.sentText: If {email} may create an account, a link arrives shortly. It works for 24 hours.
serverAdmin.visitor.confirmLead: Your address is confirmed. Choose a name and a password.
serverAdmin.visitor.doneText: Sign in with your address and password.
serverAdmin.visitor.waitText: An admin approves your account; you then get a mail.
serverAdmin.visitor.linkGone: This link is used or older than 24 hours.
serverAdmin.visitor.closedText: Ask an admin for an invitation.
serverAdmin.requests.title: Requests
serverAdmin.requests.lead: People who registered and confirmed their address.
serverAdmin.requests.approved: {name} is a member now and gets a mail.
serverAdmin.requests.declineText: No mail is sent. The address can try again after 30 days.
serverAdmin.reason.disabled: Creating accounts is off on this server.
serverAdmin.reason.domain_not_allowed: With this domain you cannot create an account here. Ask for an invitation.
serverAdmin.reason.too_many: Too many attempts. Try again later.
serverAdmin.reason.invalid_link: This link is unknown, used or expired.
serverAdmin.reason.account_exists: An account has this address by now.
serverAdmin.reason.not_pending: This request no longer waits for a decision.
serverAdmin.reason.mail_unavailable: Without a mail server no link can go out.
serverAdmin.reason.no_organization: The organization for new accounts is missing.
serverAdmin.backup.noTargetText: Until now Kalzit backs up only before updates. Set up a target, best on another drive or in S3.
serverAdmin.backup.localHint: on this server or a share
serverAdmin.backup.s3Hint: a store with the S3 API
serverAdmin.backup.keyNote: The secrets key is never in a backup. Keep it apart; a restore needs it.
serverAdmin.backup.postgres: With PostgreSQL only the files are backed up; use pg_dump for the database.
serverAdmin.backup.removeText: Scheduled backups wait until a new target is saved.
serverAdmin.backup.reason.path_refused: Not an existing folder below a backup folder, or in Kalzit’s data folder.
serverAdmin.backup.reason.path_not_writa: Kalzit cannot write or delete there.
serverAdmin.backup.reason.bucket_not_fou: Bucket not found. Kalzit creates no buckets.
serverAdmin.backup.reason.target_timeout: The store did not answer in time.
serverAdmin.backup.reason.target_blocked: The target rules refuse this address.
serverAdmin.backup.reason.interrupted: A stop or crash cut the run short.
serverAdmin.backup.reason.endpoint_inval: An http(s) address with a host and without a path.
serverAdmin.backup.reason.bucket_invalid: 3 to 63 lowercase letters, digits, dots or hyphens.
serverAdmin.backup.reason.secret_invalid: This key is too long or has control characters.
serverAdmin.backup.reason.target_failed: The store answered with an error.
serverAdmin.backup.reason.snapshot_faile: The copy of the database could not be made.
